title: Runtime should detect if suspension message has invalid index
body:
There was a bug in the sdk that was generating suspension messages with indexes outside the current journal (index >= journal_length).

We should check this and mark it as sdk bug

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This issue involves memory-related symptoms, specifically the handling of journal indexes in suspension messages, which are part of the agent's memory mechanism. Detecting and marking invalid indexes relates to memory content errors in agent systems.
